import hmac
import hashlib
import base64
import json

def b64url_encode(data: bytes) -> str:
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(data).decode('utf-8').rstrip('=')

secret = b"enterprise_super_secret_key_32bytes!"
header = json.dumps({"alg": "HS256", "typ": "JWT"}).encode('utf-8')
payload = json.dumps({"sub": "usr_fintech_42", "role": "admin", "exp": 1893456000}).encode('utf-8')

part1 = b64url_encode(header)
part2 = b64url_encode(payload)
signing_input = f"{part1}.{part2}".encode('utf-8')
sig = hmac.new(secret, signing_input, hashlib.sha256).digest()
part3 = b64url_encode(sig)

token = f"{part1}.{part2}.{part3}"
print("=== JWT CRYPTOGRAPHIC ANATOMY ===")
print(f"Generated Token Length: {len(token)} chars")
print(f"Token Segments:         {len(token.split('.'))}")
print(f"Header Segment:         {token.split('.')[0]}")
mid_b64 = token.split(".")[1]
decoded = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(mid_b64 + "==="[:(4 - len(mid_b64) % 4) % 4]))
print(f"Decoded Claims Match: {decoded == json.loads(payload.decode())}")
print("Stateless cryptographic signature created successfully.")

spec.title: CVE-2015-9235 algorithm confusion exploit vs whitelist

steps.caption: Public RSA keys are openly accessible to third parties.
Forging HS256 using the public RSA key passes naive checks.
Whitelisting allowed algorithms neutralizes RS256 downgrades cleanly.
Verify forged token behavior if algorithm whitelisting is misconfigured.

import hmac
import hashlib
import base64
import json

def b64url(b): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).decode('utf-8').rstrip('=')

# Simulated Public Key (known to everyone)
RSA_PUBLIC_KEY = b"-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----\nMIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEFAAOCAQ8A\n-----END PUBLIC KEY-----"

# Malicious forged token claiming admin role signed with public key as HMAC secret
forged_header = b64url(json.dumps({"alg": "HS256", "typ": "JWT"}).encode())
forged_payload = b64url(json.dumps({"sub": "attacker", "role": "superadmin"}).encode())
sig_input = f"{forged_header}.{forged_payload}".encode()
forged_sig = b64url(hmac.new(RSA_PUBLIC_KEY, sig_input, hashlib.sha256).digest())
forged_token = f"{forged_header}.{forged_payload}.{forged_sig}"

def secure_verify(token, allowed_algorithms=["RS256"]):
    hdr_b64 = token.split('.')[0]
    # Add padding back if needed
    hdr_json = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(hdr_b64 + '==='[:(4 - len(hdr_b64) % 4) % 4]))
    if hdr_json.get("alg") not in allowed_algorithms:
        return False, f"REJECTED: Algorithm '{hdr_json.get('alg')}' not in allowed whitelist"
    return True, "ACCEPTED"

is_valid, reason = secure_verify(forged_token, allowed_algorithms=["HS256", "RS256"])
print("=== ALGORITHM CONFUSION DEFENSE LAB ===")
print(f"Forged Token Detected: {not is_valid}")
print(f"Defense Enforcement:   {reason}")
print("Strict algorithm whitelisting successfully neutralized exploit.")

import time

class RedisBlocklistSimulator:
    def __init__(self):
        self.blocklist = {}  # jti -> expires_at

    def revoke_token(self, jti: str, ttl_seconds: int):
        self.blocklist[jti] = time.time() + ttl_seconds

    def is_revoked(self, jti: str) -> bool:
        exp = self.blocklist.get(jti)
        if not exp:
            return False
        if time.time() > exp:
            del self.blocklist[jti]  # Auto-evict expired blocklist entry
            return False
        return True

blocklist = RedisBlocklistSimulator()
token_jti = "token_uuid_9942"

# Check before revocation
before_check = blocklist.is_revoked(token_jti)
# Admin emergency revocation (TTL 300s)
blocklist.revoke_token(token_jti, ttl_seconds=-1)
after_check = blocklist.is_revoked(token_jti)

print("=== REDIS TOKEN BLOCKLIST LAB ===")
print(f"Token Revoked Before Admin Action: {before_check}")
print(f"Token Revoked After Admin Action:  {after_check}")
print(f"Active Blocklist Entries:          {len(blocklist.blocklist)}")
print("Instantaneous stateless token revocation verified.")

import time
import hmac
import hashlib
import base64
import json

def b64url(b): return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b).decode().rstrip('=')

class MicroserviceSecurityEngine:
    def __init__(self, secret: bytes):
        self.secret = secret
        self.revoked_jtis = set()

    def issue_token(self, user_id: str, role: str, jti: str, ttl: int = 900) -> str:
        header = b64url(json.dumps({"alg": "HS256", "typ": "JWT"}).encode())
        payload = b64url(json.dumps({
            "sub": user_id,
            "role": role,
            "jti": jti,
            "exp": int(time.time()) + ttl
        }).encode())
        sig = b64url(hmac.new(self.secret, f"{header}.{payload}".encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest())
        return f"{header}.{payload}.{sig}"

    def authenticate_request(self, token: str):
        parts = token.split('.')
        if len(parts) != 3:
            return False, "Malformed token"
        header_b64, payload_b64, sig_b64 = parts
        # Strict algorithm verification
        hdr = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(header_b64 + '==='[:(4 - len(header_b64)%4)%4]))
        if hdr.get("alg") != "HS256":
            return False, "Algorithm rejected"
        # Verify signature
        expected_sig = b64url(hmac.new(self.secret, f"{header_b64}.{payload_b64}".encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest())
        if not hmac.compare_digest(sig_b64, expected_sig):
            return False, "Signature invalid"
        # Check claims
        payload = json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode(payload_b64 + '==='[:(4 - len(payload_b64)%4)%4]))
        if time.time() > payload["exp"]:
            return False, "Token expired"
        if payload["jti"] in self.revoked_jtis:
            return False, "Token revoked"
        return True, payload

engine = MicroserviceSecurityEngine(secret=b"prod_microservice_secret_key_32b!")
valid_tok = engine.issue_token("alice", "admin", "jti_101")
auth_ok, claims = engine.authenticate_request(valid_tok)

# Revoke token
engine.revoked_jtis.add("jti_101")
auth_revoked, reason = engine.authenticate_request(valid_tok)

print("=== MICROSERVICE SECURITY ENGINE SYNTHESIS ===")
print(f"Initial Auth Succeeded: {auth_ok} (User: {claims['sub']})")
print(f"Post-Revocation Auth:   {auth_revoked} (Reason: {reason})")
h_b64, p_b64, s_b64 = valid_tok.split(".")
tampered_tok = f"{h_b64}.{chr(ord(p_b64[0]) ^ 1)}{p_b64[1:]}.{s_b64}"
tampered_ok, tampered_msg = engine.authenticate_request(tampered_tok)
print(f"Tampered Payload Auth: {tampered_ok} (Reason: {tampered_msg})")
print("Full security pipeline verification completed.")
